description.value: You have dark gray fur that helps you move about stealthily. Whenever you gain the hidden condition, such as by succeeding at a skill check to [[/act create-a-diversion]] or [[/act hide]], you can Step as a free action. At the GM's discretion, this movement might cause you to become observed (for instance, if you moved into an area of bright light or to a space that doesn't provide cover).

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
